facing_object.description: A black, stylized sculpture of a four-legged animal, resembling a dog or similar creature. It is standing on the wooden floor near the large glass windows/doors. The robot is facing this sculpture.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the rectangular wooden coffee table and facing the black decorative animal sculpture, when the speech topic: "commenting on trains being empty" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the speaker: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right?
